item.name: Food_Covers
item.description: Clear food-service covers sized for the cheese serving trays.
item.readyBeforeUse: Every cover is clean, sanitized, air-dry, intact, and fits its tray.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, covers protect prepared food between servings. After service, every cover is washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not display uncovered food. Tell the Food Lead.
